Occurrences.Kwic: 諸佛甚是靈明，諸人也不曾遮蔽。此便是普說底意。所以差別者何？記得黃面老子在雪山頂上，嘆曰：『奇哉！奇哉！一切眾生具有如來智慧德相，但以妄想執著而不證得。』且如何是妄想？但忘卻此一大事，觸處茫然，所作所為皆妄想也。縱然位至君侯，最為榮貴，皆是生死邊事。所以諸佛興慈運悲，出世來提持你，使你知有此大事，不做眾生。

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J39/J39nB466.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Baishan Kai of Shanxi. Baishan Dekai owns the retained deployment: lifts the whisk — the yellow-faced one on the whisk-tip sees the morning star and says the line — and the whisk laughs: quite right, very apt, yet I dare guarantee the old brother is not through.

Senses.Explanation: The line from the morning star: how strange — all beings are endowed with the thus-come one's wisdom and virtue-marks, only by deluded thinking and clinging do they fail to attain it. The whisk at Baishan's hall hears it and laughs out loud — quite right, very apt — yet dares guarantee the old brother is not through. The telling and the plain price: Dahui Zonggao tells it whole — before the mountain of right awakening the morning star appeared and Shakyamuni suddenly woke; at the place he had verified he saw the great earth and all beings of one body with him, equal, and said the line: what I verified, the ten directions' buddhas and even the wriggling creatures attained all at once — and he set the ocean-seal at each person's heel; Huanyou Zhengchuan reads it round and empty — I observe all beings are endowed with the thus-come one's wisdom and virtue-marks but by deluded thinking and clinging do not verify it; with no clinging, is that not empty? — the Diamond's beings-beings are no beings beside it; Muyun Tongmen preaches the plain price — what is deluded thinking? just forgetting this one great matter; touch any place blankly and all one does and makes is deluded thinking; Zhu'an Zhenyan has his staff report it in a loud voice — the yellow-faced old man deep on the snow ridge lifted his head at midnight, suddenly saw the morning star, made much ado and said the line — and before the sound had ended: one film over the eye, sky-flowers falling in profusion — a slap of the staff. The halls that doubt it: Binya Jian grants the whole mechanism wholly bared, the root cut through — yet inspected closely, very much like stamping from a mold; Zishui writes to a layman — the old man of the snow mountain's one piece of bitter heart is to make people wake on the spot, but people simply will not: they neglect the ordinary and hurry to seek the lofty and deep, how lamentable; Baishan Dekai lifts the whisk — the yellow-faced one on the whisk-tip enters right settledness, sees the morning star, wakes, says the line — and the whisk cannot help laughing, crying quite right, very apt, yet I dare guarantee the old brother is not through.
